implementation_error.finding: the inherited normal inventory detector used side * OI change, so a short with falling OI was treated as positive inventory confirmation
implementation_error.economic_error: price decline plus falling OI can be long liquidation, not fresh short inventory creation
implementation_error.controlled_fix: require raw exchange OI change greater than zero for ORDERLY_INVENTORY_DISPLACEMENT in both directions; change no other signal or execution variable

one_core_scenario_ablation.interpretation: removing the failed inventory mechanism turns the week positive, proving it was the dominant performance drag, but leaves only two trades and 0.348% daily growth; deletion alone has no path to the target

rejection_diagnosis.largest_negative_factor: ORDERLY_INVENTORY_DISPLACEMENT interpreted a strong one-minute break plus efficient five-minute movement and central basis as persistent inventory repricing; the two correctly positive-OI long events also failed, so raw OI creation was still not sufficient
rejection_diagnosis.why_no_more_tuning: the state failed all three executions after the original freeze and both remaining executions after the semantic correction; one-scenario removal improved expectancy but destroyed opportunity count
rejection_diagnosis.final_action: discard ORDERLY_INVENTORY_DISPLACEMENT and reject V26b/V26c as complete candidates without opening the second selected week

valid_components_retained: normal-basis failed-auction resumption remained positive in the failed week
state-interval OI measurement between acceptance and retest
absolute basis and completed parent displacement as independent acceptance dimensions
causal pivot registration and first-penetration consumption
current-NAV 3% risk sizing and NautilusTrader-only execution
next_design_requirement: add a complete independent mechanism with repeated opportunities; do not broaden one-minute inventory displacement or reintroduce side-adjusted OI
